info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Parts API

params.name: assets
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific Assets. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of Asset IDs.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

params.name: page
params.description: This parameter is used to paginate results based on the limit. Refer to Pagination section for more information.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what ID you want to start receiving results at. Without ordering, this will return results with an ID greater than the value of cursor. With ordering, this will return results starting at the next item in the order, regardless of whether its ID is greater than or lesser than the value of cursor.

params.name: start
params.description: This parameter is used to only get relations that were last edited after the unix timestamp passed into the start parameter. For example, all relations that were last edited after April 18th, 2018.

params.name: end

params.description: This parameter is used to only get associations for specific parts. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of part IDs.

params.name: vendors
params.description: This parameter is used to only get associations for specific vendors. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of vendor IDs.

params.name: vendorPartNumber
params.description: This parameter is used to search for associations by vendor part number. This parameter expects a string with the wildcard % for partial matching.

params.name: vendorName
params.description: This parameter is used to search for associations by vendor name. This parameter expects a string with the wildcard % for partial matching.

params.name: start
params.description: This parameter is used to only get associations that were last updated after the unix timestamp passed into the start parameter.

params.name: end
params.description: This parameter is used to only get associations that were last updated before the unix timestamp passed into the end parameter.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what relationID you want to start receiving results at. This will return results with a relationID greater than the value of cursor.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time. The maximum is 1000.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: This parameter is used to order results. Accepted values: relationID, -relationID, createdAt, -createdAt, updatedAt, -updatedAt, partName, -partName, vendorName, -vendorName. Prefix with - for descending order.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of vendor-part associations for the customer.

**Note:** this endpoint supports both cursor-based and page-based pagination. Please refer to the [**Pagination**](#pagination) section for more information.

Return data description

Property: relationID, Description: The unique ID of this vendor-part association.
Property: partID, Description: The ID of the associated part.
Property: vendorID, Description: The ID of the associated vendor.
Property: vendorPartNumber, Descri

Creates a new manual vendor-part association. The part and vendor must both exist and the vendor must be accessible at the part's location.

Returns `201 Created` with the new association details. Returns `409 Conflict` if the association already exists.

Deletes a vendor-part association by its `relationID`. Only manually created associations (associationType: `manual`) can be deleted through this endpoint.

Returns `204 No Content` on success. Returns `404 Not Found` if the association does not exist or does not belong to your account.
